description: This file defines the ReferencedTypeCollection class, which manages a collection of referenced Type instances, including methods for retrieving, recording, and resetting references, as well as handling type reference IDs within the Orleans.Serialization.Session namespace.

classes.name: ReferencedTypeCollection
classes.description: A collection class that manages references to Type objects, allowing for efficient serialization and deserialization by tracking referenced types and their identifiers.

methods.name: GetReferencedType
methods.description: Retrieves the Type associated with a given reference ID, throwing an exception if the reference is unknown.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the referenced Type for a given reference ID, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: RecordReferencedType
methods.description: Records a new Type in the collection, assigning it a new reference ID.

methods.name: TryGetTypeReference
methods.description: Checks if a Type has already been referenced and retrieves its reference ID if so.

methods.name: GetOrAddTypeReference
methods.description: Gets the reference ID for a Type, adding it if it does not already exist, with optimized handling for .NET 6 or greater.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the collection, clearing all referenced types and resetting the reference ID counter.
